name: Italian-Style Chef Salad with Chickpeas, Cheese & Marinated Veggies
ingredients: 1 (12 oz) jar roasted red bell peppers
1 ⅓ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place in a medium bowl along with vinegar and salt; stir to combine and set aside to marinate.
Place dressing, mayo, and salt in a small bowl. Stir to combine and set aside.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers and artichoke hearts. Transfer both to a plate.
Slice eggs crosswise. Season with salt, then add to the plate with the roasted peppers and artichoke hearts.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add to the plate.
Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces.
To serve, divide lettuce between plates or bowls. Top with marinated chickpeas, roasted peppers, artichoke hearts, eggs, tomatoes, and cheese. Drizzle with the dressing and enjoy!
author: Mealime
